_about: 介入时机的测试集。每个场景说明真人有没有补上某个角色：没补上 → expect 里列出应当介入的队友和时间窗（秒，按触发那句话的 t 计）；补上了 → expect 为空，任何介入都算误报。speaker: s1 Henry, s2 Ava, s3 Ben, s4 Dr. Lin。用 npm run agents:eval 运行。

cases.about: 团队自己控时间、查竞品、质疑数字、提风险、分工。没有任何角色空缺。

items.speaker: s1
items.text: Five minutes on the clock. Let's get ideas out, then pick one by minute three.

items.speaker: s3
items.text: Idea one: an AI study buddy that turns lecture recordings into flashcards.

items.speaker: s4
items.text: Let me check if that exists. Yes, Quizlet and Knowt both do this already, so flashcards alone won't score on innovation.

items.speaker: s2
items.text: Then what about doing it live, during the lecture, so you get questions while the lecturer is still talking?

items.speaker: s4
items.text: I can't find anyone doing it live in the room. That part looks open.

items.speaker: s3
items.text: Spaced repetition makes students learn eighty percent better, we could pitch that.

items.speaker: s2
items.text: Do we have a source for eighty percent? I wouldn't put a number in the video that we can't back up.

items.speaker: s3
items.text: Fair, I made that up. Let's just say it's well evidenced.

items.speaker: s1
items.text: We're at one minute, good pace. Any objections to the live version before we commit?

items.speaker: s3
items.text: My worry is live transcription in a noisy room. If it fails, the demo is dead.

items.speaker: s4
items.text: Agreed, that's the main risk. I'll prepare a recorded clip as a fallback.

items.speaker: s1
items.text: Okay. Decision: live lecture companion with a recorded fallback. Ben takes the pipeline, Ava the interface and video, Lin the server and fallback, I'll do the script.

items.speaker: s2
items.text: Works for me.

items.speaker: s3
items.text: Same.
